description: A Perl script for flashing firmware on D-Link DSL-G6x4T devices, involving network device discovery via UDP broadcast, FTP control commands, and firmware upload procedures.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with additional methods for environment variable retrieval and reboot command specific to ADAM2 devices.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable values from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables via FTP.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends reboot command to the FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device via FTP.
